articles.summary: Third Quarter 2026 Net Income per Diluted Share of $9.04 and Core Income per Diluted Share of $9.18 Third Quarter 2026 Return on Equity of 24.7% and Core Return on Equity of 22.1% Third quarter net income of $1.917 billion and core income of $1.947 billion. Underwriting income of $1.432 billion pre-tax and underlying underwriting income of $1.736 billion pre-tax. Strong margins with a consolidated combined ratio of 86.8% and underlying combined ratio of 84.1%. Net favorable prior year reserve development in all three segments totaled $234 million pre-tax. Net written premiums of $11.480 billion. Record net investment income of $1.098 billion pre-tax ($908 million after-tax) increased 6%. Total capital of $1.769 billion returned to shareholders, including $1.508 billion of share repurchases. The Travelers Companies, Inc. today reported net income of $1.917 billion, or $9.04 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1.888 billion, or $8.24 per diluted
articles.title: Travelers Reports Excellent Third Quarter and Year-to-Date Results
